item_type.instructions: What is the main item this Mercari listing is selling? Judge only from the text given.

criteria.iphone_15_family: An Apple iPhone 15, 15 Plus, 15 Pro or 15 Pro Max handset, including damaged, locked or for-parts phones.
criteria.other_iphone: An Apple iPhone of a different generation, e.g. iPhone 11, 12, 13, 14, 16 or 17, or an iPhone SE.
criteria.other_phone: A phone from another maker, e.g. Samsung Galaxy, Google Pixel, Motorola.
criteria.case_or_protector: A phone case, cover, skin, wallet case, or screen or camera-lens protector, sold without a phone.
criteria.charger_or_cable: A charger, charging cable, power bank, MagSafe charger or wireless charging pad, sold without a phone.
criteria.phone_part: A replacement part for a phone sold without a working phone: screen, back glass, battery, housing, camera module, logic board, or an empty box.
criteria.other_accessory: Another phone accessory: earbuds, AirPods, mounts, grips, straps, stands, camera attachments.
criteria.other: Anything else: gift cards, other electronics, unrelated products.

model.instructions: Which iPhone 15 model is this phone?

criteria.iphone_15: The base iPhone 15, not Plus, Pro or Pro Max.
criteria.not_stated: The text does not say which iPhone 15 model.

storage.instructions: How much storage does this iPhone have?

criteria.not_stated: The text does not state the storage.

carrier.instructions: Is this iPhone carrier unlocked or tied to a carrier?

criteria.unlocked: Factory or carrier unlocked, works on any carrier.
criteria.carrier_locked: Locked to a named carrier such as AT&T, Verizon, T-Mobile, Cricket, Boost, Straight Talk, Tracfone, Visible, or described as carrier locked.
criteria.not_stated: The text does not say whether it is unlocked or locked.

condition.instructions: What does the listing text say about the phone's working condition?

criteria.working: Works fully; cosmetic wear such as scratches or scuffs is still working.
criteria.cracked: Works but the screen or back glass is cracked or shattered.
criteria.faulty: Has a named functional defect such as Face ID not working, bad battery, dead pixels or lines on the screen, broken camera, not charging, no service.
criteria.activation_locked: iCloud or activation locked, blacklisted, bad IMEI, or financed and unpaid.
criteria.for_parts: Sold as is, untested, does not turn on, or for parts or repair.
criteria.not_stated: The listing does not say anything about whether it works.
